title: Radboud Scholarship Programme
about: Radboud University offers up to 26 partial scholarships for non-EU/non-EEA students entering its master's programmes in 2027/2028. Applications must be submitted in OSIRIS by 31 January 2027 and completed by 14 February 2027; decisions expected before mid-April 2027.
requirements: Application in OSIRIS by 31 January 2027; complete by 14 February 2027 at 23:59 CET
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Radboud Scholarship Programme at Radboud University in Nijmegen, Netherlands, application deadline 31 January 2027. The photo shows colourful canal houses and houseboats in Amsterdam, not Nijmegen.
